plain_description.what: Planned to rebuild the anchor-free tree 4 times for each of two embedders to see whether the filing gap between nomic and qwen3 (-0.046) is bigger than the variation between build runs.
plain_description.why: It asks whether the earlier filing loss belongs to the embedder or is just build-to-build noise.
plain_description.information: It would have separated a real embedder effect from build randomness. Result: WITHDRAWN before any data was collected. With a fixed data split, the build is effectively deterministic, so the test would only have measured a spread already known to be close to zero.
